name: posture-miniprogram
description: WeChat mini program: guest front and side photos, then a session-only Simplified Chinese training report.

scripts.check:emit: tsc -p tsconfig.json && git diff --exit-code -- miniprogram/lib && test -z "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -- miniprogram/lib)"
scripts.test: npm run build -w posture-core && npm run build -w posture-api && npm run check:emit && node --import tsx --test test/*.test.ts
scripts.smoke: npm run build -w posture-core && npm run build -w posture-api && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node --import tsx scripts/smoke.ts
